claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Digoxin at 2.5 uM inhibits Na+/K+-ATPase (ATP1A1), but in a 5-day pooled viability screen this cardiac glycoside is expected to produce little or no selective killing of cancer cell lines at this concentration.
